name: com.themoneyplays/money-plays
title: Money Plays
description: US stock and ETF ideas from finance creators, with sources, chart and SEC-filing checks. Read-only.

tools.name: list_plays
tools.description: The live investment ideas on Money Plays, one line each: tickers, what the company does, category (Hot, Hidden gem, Quiet strength, On the radar), momentum and business readings, and voices for vs. total. Use get_play for the full case.

ticker.description: Only plays that include this ticker.

tools.name: get_play
tools.description: Everything behind one play: the thesis, what would break it, what each company does (from its SEC filing), the momentum checks per ticker, the business scorecard per ticker with the filing behind each measure, and the newest voices for and against.

slug.description: The play's slug, e.g. from list_plays or search ("nvda-ai-chip-demand").

tools.name: get_voices
tools.description: Every mention of a play, newest first, 20 per page: who said it, where, for or against, the quote or full post, and the source link (YouTube links start at the moment the point is made).

slug.description: The play's slug, e.g. from list_plays or search ("nvda-ai-chip-demand").

tools.name: find_ticker
tools.description: What a company does (from its latest SEC filing) and every play it has appeared in on Money Plays, live or archived, with each play's readings.

tools.name: market_gauges
tools.description: The latest VIX reading, its zone (Calm, Normal, Fear, Panic) and how the S&P 500 did 3 and 12 months after past days in each zone.

tools.name: sources
tools.description: The hand-picked YouTube channels and X accounts Money Plays reads. Discord communities are private, so only their number is given.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search live Money Plays plays by ticker, company name or topic. Returns ids to pass to fetch for the full case.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: The full case for one play by its id (slug) from search, as a single document with its source URL.
